I thought all you sardine-fucking dipshits were dead!|Ma June to [[Lucy MacLean]]|sound=Ma June.ogg}} '''Ma June''' is the proprietor of [[Ma June's Sundries]], a store in [[Filly]], and an associate of [[Siggi Wilzig]] {{in|FOTV}}. ==Background== Ma June implies that she has been in the [[Los Angeles]] area since at least the [[Fall of Shady Sands|destruction of Shady Sands]]. She was aware of both the [[New California Republic]] and the [[Enclave]].[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"So you met my sister?"''
[[Ma June]]: ''"Yeah, back in Filly. Before the Brotherhood of Steel burnt it down. Had her help a fella from the Enclave get through the Shithole to some folks from the NCR who weren't in town when Shady Sands blew up. Pretty slim odds. What with it being Khan country."''
({{FOTV|2|5}}) She was also familiar with the [[Vault]]s, and came to resent the Vaults and their residents for living sheltered lives compared to the rest of the surface. By 2296, Ma June had been operating a general store in the town of Filly, together with another person named [[Barv]]. Her store sold various supplies, including sundries, weapons, electronics, "rarities," and more. Around that time, she struck a deal with [[Lee Moldaver]], leader of an NCR remnant force in Los Angeles, to arrange for Enclave defector [[Siggi Wilzig]] to be transported to Moldaver's headquarters at [[Griffith Observatory]]. However, Filly was forcefully seized by the [[Knights of San Fernando]] as part of their manhunt for Wilzig, and they burned down the town after it had served its purpose for them. Ma June and Barv subsequently moved to the former [[Vault-Tec headquarters (TV series)|Vault-Tec headquarters]], where they began farming [[Radroach (TV series)|radroaches]] for a living.[[Claudia (TV series)|Claudia]]: ''"Can I ask you a question?"''
[[Barv]]: ''"Mm-hmm."''
Claudia: ''"What is making that noise in the elevator?"''
Barv: ''"Roach farm."''
Claudia: ''"How big are they?"''
Barv: ''"Not big enough for market yet, but they'll get there."''
({{FOTV|2|5}}) ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===Season 1=== {{Quotation|A trader in the small junk town of Filly, Ma June will trade with anyone — so long as they have the caps. Just remember, she didn’t establish her position by being a pushover. Cross her, and you’ll find yourself on the business end of rifle.{{sic}}|[[Fallout season 1 Amazon overview|''Fallout'' season 1 character description]]}} ====[[The Target]]==== [[Lucy MacLean]] encounters Ma June sometime after leaving [[Vault 33]]. Lucy points out that Ma June has [[Vault-Tec Corporation]] items in her store and assumes Ma June does business with criminals, mentioning she is searching for one. Ma June is amused that Lucy is a real [[Vault]] dweller and laughs in her face. Ma June's attitude hardens when Lucy mentions [[Lee Moldaver]], and she orders Lucy to leave immediately. Lucy asserts she wants to save her father, but Ma June is skeptical that Lucy will live long on the surface. Lucy mentions the Vaults' mission to save America, but Ma June denounces the Vaults as "a hole in the ground for rich folks to hide in while the rest of the world burned." Ma June says, "fuck the Vaults," and gives Lucy the finger. Lucy then leaves, despondent. [[File:FOTV S1 Amazon promo 9.jpg|thumb|250px|Outside her store with Lucy and Wilzig]] Ma June notes [[Siggi Wilzig]] speaking to Lucy outside. She asks Wilzig if he is Wilzig and tells him to get inside, while she orders Lucy to go. [[The Ghoul]] arrives since he is tracking Wilzig for a bounty. Ma June reacts with suspicion towards the Ghoul, telling him that his "kind" (ghouls) are not welcome in Filly. Ma June mentions she herself has been paid a lot of caps to transport Wilzig to his next destination. The Ghoul shoots off Wilzig's leg, making Ma June shout she has 1000 caps for whoever kills the Ghoul, but that no one will get anything if she kills him first. In the ensuing firefight, Ma June shoots the Ghoul, but he shoots her in the knee. When Lucy stands up for Wilzig, Ma June finds Lucy's articulate speech ridiculous. [[Maximus]] arrives to fight the Ghoul, letting Lucy bandage Ma June's knee. In the back room, Ma June tries to assist Wilzig with his leg injury by putting on a makeshift leg. She asks Lucy to take Wilzig to her client, who happens to be Moldaver and says Lucy can bargain with Moldaver with Wilzig. Ma June puts Moldaver's location into Lucy's Pip-Boy and tries to motivate Lucy before she leaves. It is unknown what happened to Ma June and Barv after Lucy and Wilzig left, as they aren't seen in their deserted storefront when the Ghoul entered looking for clues. It is also unclear if they returned after that before Filly was taken over by the [[Knights of San Fernando]], with their shop in particular being turned into an armory. ===Season 2=== ====[[The Wrangler]]==== After the Brotherhood acquired the cold fusion technology by defeating Moldaver's NCR remnants, according to Ma, they burned Filly down, forcing the survivors of their initial takeover to move elsewhere. Ma June and Barv found their way to the abandoned [[Vault-Tec headquarters (TV series)|Vault-Tec headquarters]] in Los Angeles and turned the lobby into their new home. They also created makeshift pens out of the old elevator shafts to support a [[Radroach (TV series)|radroach]] breeding farm. The pair left their new home at some point before the arrival of the [[Vault 31 dweller]] expedition led by [[Norm MacLean]], and came back shortly after they arrived, holding them at gunpoint until Norm was able to resolve the tension. In a private conversation with Norm, Ma revealed her previous encounter with his sister Lucy and tried to catch Norm up on current events until she is told he has no idea who groups like the Enclave, the NCR, or the Khans even are. She drops the matter to then tell him his sister is most likely dead. She and Barv head off again, before which Ma offers the expedition to take what they want from their stash. When Barv remarks on Ma June's sudden sense of charity, she says it's her attempt to be a better person, for what it's worth. ==Personality== Ma June is a stern and tough woman who does not establish her position by being a pushover. She will trade with anyone as long as they have the caps. However, she is also willing to threaten people with a gun if they betray her.[https://www.amazon.com/Fallout-Season-1/dp/B0CN4HV16N Amazon show description] She shares the common disdainful opinion of the [[Vault]]s and their inhabitants like most wastelanders, viewing Vault dwellers as naive idealists detached from the reality of the wasteland due to their isolation as well as, in her eyes, a living reminder that the underground bunkers were only ever intended to ensure the survival of the [[United States of America|American]] upper class at the expense of everyone else on the day the bombs dropped. She also has a prejudice against [[ghoul]]s, openly warning the Ghoul that "his kind" are not welcome in Filly when the bounty hunter comes for his target. After encountering Lucy and later losing her home, Ma's harsh attitude towards Vault dwellers seems to have softened a bit as she is more patient with Norm's inexperience with the wasteland, but is no less firm in telling him that he and his fellows "vaulties" won't be safe anywhere but in a Vault. ==Inventory== {{Inventory |game =FOTV |title =yes |apparel =[[Ma June jacket|Ma June's jacket]]
